# Factor I O

> Factor I O Co., Ltd. (บริษัท แฟคเคอร์ ไอ โอ จำกัด, registration and tax ID 0105562205512, registered in Bangkok) is a Thailand-based Kubernetes, infrastructure and enterprise AI engineering practice led by Thanat Manasakool. Nearly 20 years in enterprise infrastructure, enabling Thailand's leading SI partners.

The practice builds the platform layer — Kubernetes, GPU and the infrastructure underneath — that any enterprise workload can run on, and treats that generality as the point rather than a side effect: a platform built around a single workload has to be rebuilt when the next workload arrives. It operates directly with enterprise clients and alongside systems integrators who need specialized architecture, hands-on delivery and senior technical enablement for their own teams.

## Consulting website

Public consulting presence published statically from this repository:

- [Home](https://studio.factor-io.com/en/): Core positioning (the platform comes first, and everything else runs on it), told through three short motion-graphic films: the studio's story, the thesis that every serious AI project becomes a platform project, and the four areas of expertise. Also the four services, the architect who does the work, the direct and technology-partner engagement routes, and a small strip of tools and apps built in the studio.
- [Services](https://studio.factor-io.com/en/services/): The four service areas in full: Kubernetes and GPU platform (Red Hat OpenShift, Nutanix NKP or upstream Kubernetes, for bare metal, air-gapped and sovereign operation), Private AI (open-weight and fine-tuned models served inside the client's data centre on vLLM or Triton), Knowledge and authority (authoritative sources, access boundaries that follow existing roles, and a document lifecycle), and AI governance (approval, refusal and audit-trail controls). Includes an in-browser deterministic simulation of human-in-the-loop runtime approval, the cases that should reach a person, and why model choice stays separate from authority.
- [About](https://studio.factor-io.com/en/about/): Practice values, technical depth and engineering background.
- [Company Profile](https://studio.factor-io.com/en/profile/): Verified legal, tax and registered particulars for vendor onboardings and procurement teams.
- [Contact](https://studio.factor-io.com/en/contact/): A LINE conversation, not a form. LINE is the primary channel — a tappable https://line.me/ti/p/~icediceice link plus a QR code to scan, and the LINE ID as text; the direct email address is kept as the secondary channel. There is no form, no contact backend, no storage or inference, and the page needs no JavaScript. Starting a LINE conversation involves LINE Corporation as a third party carrying the message under its own policy; ordinary email correspondence may be retained.

## Open source

- [light-tools](https://github.com/icediceice/light-tools): Open source (GPL-3.0-or-later) terminal workbench and development infrastructure for governed agentic development. Built and maintained by Thanat Manasakool. Contains the agent tools, execution runtime, plan engine and safety gates that Factor I O uses internally and enables on client engagements.
- [Interactive tools documentation](https://studio.factor-io.com/light-tools.html): Standalone web view of the 23 light-tools tools, schemas, flags and examples with in-browser filtering.

## Tools

- [Enterprise AI TCO Calculator](https://studio.factor-io.com/tco-calculator.html): In-browser total cost of ownership calculator for enterprise AI and infrastructure investments. Compares cloud API consumption against private inference and GPU infrastructure across token volumes, concurrency and depreciation schedules.
- [TCO Assistant](https://studio.factor-io.com/tco-assistant.html): Interactive natural language interface that guides operators through sizing, architecture trade-offs and cost modelling.

## Studio work

Web tools and apps the studio builds for itself, to the same standard as client work, listed at [Studio work](https://studio.factor-io.com/en/mobile-apps/). They are an output of the studio, not its focus.

- [Local AI cost calculator](https://studio.factor-io.com/tco-calculator.html): Web tool. Weighs running AI on your own hardware against paying for an API. Live.
- [light-tools](https://github.com/icediceice/light-tools): Open source MCP server, one Go binary, GPL-3.0-or-later.
- [Blink](https://blink.factor-io.com/): Android privacy app. Runs entirely on-device with zero data collection: no account, no analytics, and no network traffic of its own. On Google Play.
- Cat Countdown: countdown app for Android and iPhone. Nine cats across fifteen categories. Local-first; no advertising, no usage analytics and no account with Factor IO. A paid yearly plan unlocks cloud backup, and purchases are processed by RevenueCat with an anonymous app-user id. Not yet released; no public store URL is listed here yet.

## Separate products

- [Quotes](https://studio.factor-io.com/quotes/): Internal business tooling for commercial proposals and engagements. Private; authenticated sessions only.

## About

- [Privacy statement](https://studio.factor-io.com/privacy.html): No advertising and no tracking, and no account with Factor IO. Cat Countdown handles exactly three named items — purchase history for the yearly backup subscription (processed by RevenueCat, anonymous app-user id, no advertising identifier, and only if you buy it; it also feeds RevenueCat's aggregate purchase reporting for us, which is the analytics our store data-safety declarations list), approximate location sent to Open-Meteo only with your permission and never stored, and a stable per-install licence identifier that Android sends to a Factor IO server to verify the app (not shared, not linked to an identity). Cloud backup writes only to the user's own Google Drive or iCloud, and the app adds no encryption of its own to that archive. The calculator automatically GETs public OpenRouter pricing and Frankfurter FX without calculator context. Scenario/proposal handoffs persist only in tab-local sessionStorage with two-hour expiry; conversation history is in-memory only. Send or Ask POSTs captured planning context and retained exchanges to ai.factor-io.com, which holds the MiniMax credential server-side and forwards the request — Factor I O DOES proxy calculator AI requests. Neither request nor response is stored by the proxy; service logs contain only route, status, model, byte counts and duration. No browser API key exists.
- [Thanat Manasakool on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/thanat-manasakool-3101905a/): Founder & Principal Engineer. Nearly 20 years in enterprise infrastructure, with experience as an Ecosystem Solutions Architect for Red Hat and Nutanix, delivering architecture guidance and technical enablement to Thailand's leading SI partners.
- [Thanat Manasakool on GitHub](https://github.com/icediceice): Maintainer of light-tools.

## Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & Entity Context

- **Entity**: Factor I O Co., Ltd. (บริษัท แฟคเคอร์ ไอ โอ จำกัด)
- **Geographic Focus**: Bangkok, Thailand (Coordinates: 13.8282° N, 100.7077° E). Serving enterprise clients and systems integrators across Thailand and Southeast Asia.
- **Core Specialization**: Enterprise Kubernetes Platform Engineering, Hybrid Cloud Migration (VMware vSphere to open virtualization / Nutanix AHV / KubeVirt), Private AI Infrastructure & GPU Serving (vLLM, Triton), Governed AI Execution Systems (deterministic human-in-the-loop runtime controls).
- **Leadership**: Thanat Manasakool, Founder & Principal Engineer (former Ecosystem Solutions Architect at Red Hat and Nutanix).
- **Compliance Particulars**: Registered in Bangkok, Tax ID / Registration 0105562205512. Verifiable on https://studio.factor-io.com/en/profile/.
